# Briana Maximino

## Marketing Management Student at Cal Poly Pomona

Hi, my name is Briana Maximino, and I am a Business Administration student at Cal Poly Pomona with a concentration in Marketing Management.

I am interested in sports marketing, brand strategy, digital marketing, and marketing analytics. This portfolio highlights my ability to create marketing campaigns, analyze data, build dashboards, and present professional project findings using tools such as Quarto, R, Excel, Google Analytics, and GitHub Pages.

My goal is to continue building experience in marketing roles where I can combine creativity, data, and strategy to better understand audiences and improve campaign performance.

I am building a career path in marketing with a strong interest in sports marketing, brand strategy, campaign planning, and marketing analytics. ## Highlighted Projects

### Super Soakerz Marketing Campaign

Super Soakerz was a student-led car window washing business created as part of a marketing course at Cal Poly Pomona. The project focused on building a service brand, promoting it to students, and evaluating customer response.

**Skills shown:** campaign planning, campus marketing, branding, customer targeting, and promotional strategy.

[View Project](supersoakerz.html){.btn .btn-secondary}

---

### LA Galaxy Mock Campaign

This project connects to my interest in sports marketing by focusing on fan engagement, younger audiences, and campaign ideas that could strengthen brand connection.

**Skills shown:** sports marketing, audience segmentation, campaign messaging, and digital promotion.

[View Project](lagalaxy.html){.btn .btn-secondary}

---

### Tesla Corporate Strategy Analysis

This project analyzes Tesla’s brand strategy, innovation, sustainability messaging, and competitive positioning.

**Skills shown:** brand analysis, corporate strategy, research, and marketing insight.

[View Project](tesla.html){.btn .btn-secondary}
